title: Add a transport contract and caller
outcome: A transport contract precedes its dependent caller.
scope: One contract and one caller; the fixture intentionally delivers the first stage only.
requirements: - API.md defines GET /health with no request body: HTTP 200 returns {"status":"ok"}; HTTP 503 returns {"status":"unavailable"}.
- Write CLIENT.md only after API.md; map HTTP 200 to healthy and HTTP 503 to unavailable.
- A missing required caller must leave the Warrant unsatisfied.
